blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Confusing bearing wall with any wall that touches a load—bearing walls must carry superimposed loads, not just their own weight (thresholds defined in LEA-STRC-002-04)","Thinking frame systems cannot have shear walls—frames require lateral bracing (shear walls, diaphragms, or moment connections)","Assuming bearing walls are always masonry—RC shear wall systems are bearing systems, and light-gauge stud walls can be bearing if they carry required loads"]} />
